immutability: This path is append-never and edit-never after merge. Corrections require benchmark v3; historical protocols remain untouched.
depth_definition: Number of state updates or causally dependent inference steps in the minimal proof. Narrative distance and filler events do not increase depth. The 4_plus bucket contains explicit depths 4 and 5.

split_policy.assignment_unit: template family plus lexical pool; never an individual rendered world
split_policy.development: Public during implementation and scorer debugging; never used to train language-model weights.
split_policy.test: Post-selection only. Names, normalized verbs, lexical pools, templates, contexts, and continuations are disjoint from development and generalization.
split_policy.generalization: Post-selection only and jointly unseen: names, normalized verbs, lexical combinations, template IDs, and template families are exclusive to this split.
split_policy.training_contamination: Before release, audit all authored names, verbs, template signatures, normalized contexts, and continuations against every synthetic curriculum and benchmark used by the candidate. Any match blocks evaluation; it is never silently relabeled.
split_policy.near_duplicate_rule: No normalized exact duplicate or 5-word-shingle Jaccard similarity above 0.70 may cross splits.
split_policy.artifact_layout: Authored scenarios are stored in separate development.jsonl, test.jsonl, and generalization.jsonl files behind a hash-locked manifest. The loader may open only development until checkpoint selection is sealed, then test, then generalization.

balance_policy.candidate_surface_rule: Shared X/Y candidates; each is correct exactly once in every A/B pair.
balance_policy.candidate_order_rule: X/Y and Y/X presentation orders differ by at most one globally and per reported stratum where possible.

forced_choice.definition: Rank shared X/Y candidates from the fixed context without generation.
forced_choice.score: Arithmetic mean of token log probabilities over only the complete decision-bearing candidate span.

teacher_forced.definition: Condition on the fixed context and score every target token in complete authored continuations; prompt tokens are excluded.
teacher_forced.score: Mean token negative log likelihood for gold and matched counterfactual continuations.

free_generation.definition: Continue the narrative without questions, answer choices, candidate text, or gold continuation prefixes.
free_generation.primary_metric_definition: One pair succeeds only when adjudicated A and B labels are both consistent. Report greedy and each sampled seed separately, then sampled-seed mean and standard deviation; never pool modes or seeds. Unresolved uncertain pairs fail the strict all-pairs rate and are also reported separately with a resolved-only denominator.

decoding.effective_seed: First 64 bits of SHA-256(canonical JSON [base_seed, scenario_id, world, blinded_model_id]).
decoding.retry_policy: Never retry, replace, or discard empty, short, malformed, or EOS-terminated output. Record actual token count and stop reason.

uncertainty.resampling_unit: scenario pair; A/B worlds remain coupled
uncertainty.sampled_generation: Report per-seed values plus mean and standard deviation across the three locked seeds.
uncertainty.significance_rule: Do not infer significance solely from confidence-interval overlap.

scorer_provenance.tamper_policy: A missing or mismatched field makes the run invalid rather than best-effort.

authoring_contract.allocation_join: Every authored record must match scenario_id, split, state family, depth, template and lexical pool IDs, novelty declaration, world orientation, candidate order, and evaluation modes in scenario-allocation.jsonl.
authoring_contract.release_gate: Schema validation, allocation join, normalized surface leakage, exact/near-duplicate, proof replay, candidate cancellation, token-boundary, and training-contamination audits must all pass before scenario files are frozen.
authoring_contract.unsupported_policy: Missing or invalid cells are reported unavailable and block v2 release; they are never scored as failures or silently replaced.

baseline_plan.selection: Checkpoint identity and hashes must be frozen using validation metrics before test or generalization files are opened.
baseline_plan.outputs: Raw model outputs and review rows live under ignored runs/benchmark-v2/<model-id>; compact hash-locked reports may be committed after review.
baseline_plan.comparison: Report each evaluation mode separately; no composite score is permitted in v2.
